source_article_title: The Myth of the Dead Database: Why Timing, Not Interest, Killed Most of Your Lost Enquiries
carousel_title: The Myth of the Dead Database

slides.headline: The Myth of the Dead Database
slides.supporting_line: Why timing, not interest, is the real reason old enquiries go quiet.

image.direction: Filing cabinet drawer transitioning into a glowing pipeline graphic.

slides.headline: Every Enquiry Already Cost You Something
slides.body: Marketing spend, staff time and trust were already paid for the moment someone reached out — none of that disappears just because the conversation went cold.

image.direction: Small corner image, a calendar with faded dates.

slides.headline: Speed Wins New Leads, Not Old Ones
slides.body: Agencies that respond within 24 hours convert far more often than those that don't — but that same urgency trains attention away from enquiries that are only a few months old.

slides.headline: A CRM Is Not a Filing Cabinet
slides.body: Owning a database and actively working it are two different things — without a reason to revisit older enquiries, they simply sit there unused.

slides.headline: Ready vs. Not Ready Yet
slides.body: The old lens was interested or not — write it off and move on. The better lens is ready or not ready yet, because circumstances change and today's silence isn't tomorrow's answer.

slides.headline: Reopen the Conversation
slides.body: A stalled enquiry from someone who already knows your agency isn't a cold approach — it's a conversation picking back up where it paused.

image.direction: Full-width strip image, two people mid-conversation in warm tones.

slides.headline: One Question Reopens the Conversation
slides.body: Before you spend more on new leads, ask every old enquiry the same simple question: has anything changed since we last spoke?
slides.soft_cta: See what's already in your CRM.

image.direction: Magnifying glass hovering over a CRM dashboard.

emphasis_instructions.phrase: has anything changed since we last spoke
